dedupe_keys.name: manngis open data isle of man government open geospatial data hub

description: MannGIS Open Data is the Isle of Man Government's public platform for exploring and downloading open geospatial data, built on ArcGIS Hub. The home page read on 2026-09-28 invites users to explore and download open datasets, combine them on maps and build web and mobile applications, and shows data categories and featured items such as postcode centroids and walking routes, a MannGIS map gallery and a contact address (MannGIS@gov.im). Coverage is the Isle of Man, a Crown dependency. Access is free through the hub, which usually offers each layer as a download and as web services; no licence is stated on the home page and each dataset page may carry its own terms. Caveats: the dataset list was not read, the page footer dates from 2023 so some layers may be stale, and infrastructure layers such as networks are not confirmed. It supports reference layers for hazard exposure and service accessibility studies on the island, such as postcode-level exposure to flooding. Related records: data-iom-indicative-flood-risk-maps covers the island's flood maps.
